verdict.rationale: Kick documents the building blocks of a month-end close: account reconciliation "typically done once a month at close," an accrual ledger on the Plus plan, period locks applied when the accountant finishes reviewing and closing a period, and an Activity audit trail. MCP/CLI is also pitched for automating "month-end checks." However, nothing in the evidence shows a close checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals and review sign-offs as tasks; the lock is the only sign-off-like step. Missing for 10: a native close checklist or task tracker, per-item status tracking for reconciliations and accruals, a documented reviewer sign-off workflow beyond period locking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
